name: Infantry_Chat
author: Infantry AI
description: COMMS mail tools: inbox, read, message, announce and the project directory. Daemon half only (image upload frames await a host files import).

tools.name: infantry_announce
tools.description: Announce one message to every live agent of your project (one COMMS mail each). Only the roles in setting announce.allowedRoles (default owner, pm) may announce.

tools.name: infantry_inbox
tools.description: Your COMMS inbox: counts and one line per item, newest unread first. Params: limit, offset, unreadOnly, previews.

tools.name: infantry_read
tools.description: Read one message of your inbox in full and mark it read.

tools.name: infantry_message
tools.description: Send COMMS mail to an agent id, a role, a session id, or role@project (needs allowCrossProject).

tools.name: infantry_projects
tools.description: Look up projects: id, name, description and the roles with a live session.
